name: VisCode-Multi-679K and VisPlotBench
description: VisCode-Multi-679K is a large-scale dataset with 679K validated and executable visualization samples across 12 programming languages, including multi-turn correction dialogues. VisPlotBench is a benchmark for systematic evaluation of visualization coding agents, featuring executable tasks, rendered outputs, and protocols for initial generation and multi-round self-debug.
reputation: An emerging benchmark/dataset for visualization coding agents that is likely to be used in agentic code-generation and self-debug research, but is not yet widely established.
notes: Focuses on multi-language visualization coding with multi-turn correction dialogues; includes a large dataset and a benchmark with executable tasks and self-debug protocols.
